The two inner shelf boards (rows 13 and 21) are 1-row dark lines with no visible top plane. The body below, with books in rows 6-27 and a base in rows 28-31, is entirely vertical front face. styleAnswer.evidence: Density is fine on the numbers: 20 visible tones per tile, matching the well (20) and above the stall (17), with 0% near-flat coverage. The books supply most of that variety through their many spine colours. The wooden frame itself is shallow, with about 3 lightness steps (light edge, mid, dark) against the 5-6 steps Beodeul uses per material, and it has little grain or per-plank highlighting. The dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral, so the outline reads as a uniform near-black line around the whole piece. That is the sticker look, because the wood should be edged in a dark brown tone. The Beodeul wood and roof props (well 33%, bench 44%, stall 1%) lean much more toward tinted edges. The piece is clean and readable but below the Beodeul bar on outline and material shading.
